player_facing_text: Ila shrugs, her gaze flickering briefly toward the shuttered smokehouse before returning to you. "I’m just a humble fish seller," she says evenly. "As for that place, I can’t rightly say why it’s closed today. You might ask around the neighborhood or check with the ward’s watch if you want to know more."
